targets.query: from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heizung" and r._field == "temp_c") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: if r.stelle == "aussen" then "Außen (LOGO)" else if r.stelle == "kessel" then "Kessel" else if r.stelle == "kessel_soll" then "Kessel Soll" else if r.stelle == "boiler" then "Boiler" else if r.stelle == "vl_1og_ost" then "Vorlauf 1. OG Ost" else if r.stelle == "vl_3og" then "Vorlauf 3. OG" else if r.stelle == "vl_kg_2og_west" then "Vorlauf KG–2. OG Ost" else if r.stelle == "vl_kg_2og_ost" then "Vorlauf Dachgeschoss" else if r.stelle == "vl_dg" then "Vorlauf KG–2. OG West" else r.stelle }))
from(bucket: "solar") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "heizung" and r._field == "on" and r.stelle == "boiler") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
